099        @Override
100        public void generateForSector(ThemeGenContext context, float allowedUnusedFraction) {
101                
102                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("\n\n\n");
103                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Generating misc derelicts etc in all systems");
104                //getSortedAvailableConstellations(context, true, new Vector2f(), null).size()
105                List<StarSystemData> all = new ArrayList<StarSystemData>();
106                
107                /* this adds misc stuff to systems that are:
108                        1) Not tagged with some other theme
109                        2) But does add misc stuff to derelict-tagged systems
110                        So, basicallly it covers:
111                                derelict theme + whatever few constellations didn't get anything from any theme
112                */
113                for (Constellation c : context.constellations) {
114                        String theme = context.majorThemes.get(c);
115                        
116                        List<StarSystemData> systems = new ArrayList<StarSystemData>();
117                        for (StarSystemAPI system : c.getSystems()) {
118                                StarSystemData data = computeSystemData(system);
119                                systems.add(data);
120                        }
121                        
122                        for (StarSystemData data  : systems) {
123                                //if (data.system.getName().toLowerCase().contains("alpha mok morred")) {
124//                              if (data.system.getName().toLowerCase().contains("vasuki")) {
125//                                      System.out.println("efwefwef");
126//                              }
127                                boolean derelict = data.system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_DERELICT);
128                                if (!derelict && theme != null && !data.system.getTags().isEmpty()) continue;
129//                              if (!derelict && theme != null && !theme.equals(Themes.DERELICTS) &&
130//                                              !theme.equals(Themes.NO_THEME)) continue;
131                                
132                                if (random.nextFloat() > PROB_TO_ADD_SOMETHING || (derelict && theme != null)) {
133                                        data.system.addTag(Tags.THEME_MISC_SKIP);
134                                        continue;
135                                }
136
137                                populateNonMain(data);
138                                all.add(data);
139                                data.system.addTag(Tags.THEME_MISC);
140                                data.system.addTag(Tags.THEME_INTERESTING_MINOR);
141                        }
142                }
143                
144                
145                SpecialCreationContext specialContext = new SpecialCreationContext();
146                specialContext.themeId = getThemeId();
147                SalvageSpecialAssigner.assignSpecials(all, specialContext);
148                
149                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Finished generating misc derelicts\n\n\n\n\n");
150                
151                
152                int minLegionsNonRec = 2;
153                int maxLegionsNonRec = 3;
154                int minLegionsRec = 1;
155                int maxLegionsRec = 2;
156                if (Misc.isExtended() && Global.getSettings().getBoolean("ext_reduceLegionXIVSpawns")) {
157                        minLegionsNonRec = 1;
158                        maxLegionsNonRec = 2;
159                        minLegionsRec = 1;
160                        maxLegionsRec = 1;
161                }
162
163                boolean badCondition = Misc.isExtended() && Global.getSettings().getBoolean("ext_reduceDerelictQuality");
164                
165                addDerelicts(context, "legion_xiv_Elite", minLegionsNonRec, maxLegionsNonRec, minLegionsRec, maxLegionsRec, badCondition, Tags.THEME_REMNANT);
166                
167                
168                addDerelicts(context, "phantom_Elite", 1, 2, 0, 1, badCondition, Tags.THEME_REMNANT, Tags.THEME_RUINS, Tags.THEME_DERELICT, Tags.THEME_UNSAFE);
169                addDerelicts(context, "revenant_Elite", 1, 2, 0, 1, badCondition, Tags.THEME_REMNANT, Tags.THEME_RUINS, Tags.THEME_DERELICT, Tags.THEME_UNSAFE);
170                
171                
172                addRedPlanet(context);
173                addPKSystem(context);
174                addSolarShadesAndMirrors(context);
175                
176                addCoronalTaps(context);
177                
178                addExtraGates(context);
179                
180                addLOCRPiratePlanet(context);
181                addLOCRLuddicPlanet(context);
182                //addLOCRUtopiaPlanet(context);
183                addLOCRMinersPlanet(context);
184        }

186        protected void addRedPlanet(ThemeGenContext context) {
187                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Looking for planetary shield planet");
188                
189                PlanetAPI bestHab = null;
190                PlanetAPI bestNonHab = null;
191//              OrbitGap gapHab = null;
192//              OrbitGap gapNonHab = null;
193                float habDist = 0;
194                float nonHabDist = 0;
195
196                // looking for a habitable planet furthest from the Sector's center, with a bit of 
197                // a random factor
198                int systemsChecked = 0;
199                for (Constellation c : context.constellations) {
200                        for (StarSystemAPI system : c.getSystems()) {
201                                if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_SPECIAL)) continue;
202                                
203                                if (!system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_MISC_SKIP) && 
204                                                !system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_MISC)) {
205                                        continue;
206                                }
207                                //[theme_derelict, theme_derelict_probes, theme_misc_skip, theme_derelict_survey_ship]
208                                if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_DERELICT)) {
209                                        continue;
210                                }
211                                
212                                systemsChecked++;
213                                
214                                for (PlanetAPI curr : system.getPlanets()) {
215                                        if (curr.isStar()) continue;
216                                        if (curr.isMoon()) continue;
217                                        if (!curr.getMarket().isPlanetConditionMarketOnly()) continue;
218                                        
219                                        if (curr.hasTag(Tags.NOT_RANDOM_MISSION_TARGET)) continue;
220                                        
221                                        float dist = system.getLocation().length() + random.nextFloat() * 6000;
222                                        if (curr.getMarket().hasCondition(Conditions.HABITABLE)) {
223                                                if (dist > habDist) {
224//                                                      List<OrbitGap> gaps = findGaps(curr, 50f, 500f, 100f);
225//                                                      if (!gaps.isEmpty()) {
226                                                                habDist = dist;
227                                                                bestHab = curr;
228//                                                              gapHab = gaps.get(0);
229//                                                      }
230                                                }
231                                        } else {
232                                                if (dist > nonHabDist) {
233//                                                      List<OrbitGap> gaps = findGaps(curr, 50f, 500f, 100f);
234//                                                      if (!gaps.isEmpty()) {
235                                                                nonHabDist = dist;
236                                                                bestNonHab = curr;
237//                                                              gapNonHab = gaps.get(0);
238//                                                      }
239                                                }
240                                        }
241                                }
242                        }
243                }
244                
245                PlanetAPI planet = bestHab;
246                //OrbitGap gap = gapHab;
247                if (planet == null) {
248                        planet = bestNonHab;
249                        //gap = gapNonHab;
250                }
251
252                if (planet != null) {
253                        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Adding Planetary Shield to [" + planet.getName() + "] in [" + planet.getContainingLocation().getNameWithLowercaseType() + "]");
254                        PlanetaryShield.applyVisuals(planet);
255                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(PLANETARY_SHIELD_PLANET_KEY, planet);
256                        planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(PLANETARY_SHIELD_PLANET, true);
257                        planet.getStarSystem().addTag(Tags.THEME_SPECIAL);
258                        
259                        long seed = StarSystemGenerator.random.nextLong();
260                        planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SEED, seed);
261                        planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SPEC_ID_OVERRIDE, "red_planet");
262                        planet.addTag(Tags.NOT_RANDOM_MISSION_TARGET);
263                        //planet.addTag(Tags.SALVAGEABLE);
264                        
265//                      SectorEntityToken beacon = Misc.addWarningBeacon(planet, gap, Tags.BEACON_HIGH);
266//                      beacon.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(PLANETARY_SHIELD_BEACON, true);
267//                      beacon.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SEED, seed);
268                        
269                } else {
270                        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Failed to find a planet in remnant systems");
271                }
272                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Finished adding Planetary Shield planet\n\n\n\n\n");
273        }

275        protected void addDerelicts(ThemeGenContext context, String variant,
276                        int minNonSalvageable, int maxNonSalvageable, 
277                        int minSalvageable, int maxSalvageable, 
278                        String ... allowedThemes) {
279                addDerelicts(context, variant, minNonSalvageable, maxNonSalvageable, minSalvageable,
280                                                maxSalvageable, false, allowedThemes);
281        }
282        protected void addDerelicts(ThemeGenContext context, String variant,
283                                        int minNonSalvageable, int maxNonSalvageable, 
284                                        int minSalvageable, int maxSalvageable,
285                                        boolean badCondition,
286                                        String ... allowedThemes) {
287                if (Global.getSettings().getVariant(variant) != null) {
288                        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Adding " + variant + " to star systems");
289                        
290                        Set<String> tags = new HashSet<String>(Arrays.asList(allowedThemes));
291                        
292                        int numSalvageable = minSalvageable + random.nextInt(maxSalvageable - minSalvageable + 1);
293                        int numNonSalvageable = minNonSalvageable + random.nextInt(maxNonSalvageable - minNonSalvageable + 1);
294                        
295                        if (Misc.isExtended()) {
296                                float f = Misc.getDerelictRecoverableFraction();
297                                int keep = (int) Math.round(numSalvageable * f);
298                                if (keep == 0 && numSalvageable > 0) keep = 1;
299                                numNonSalvageable += numSalvageable - keep;
300                                numSalvageable = keep;
301                        }
302                        
303                        List<Constellation> list = new ArrayList<Constellation>(context.constellations);
304                        Collections.shuffle(list, random);
305                        
306                        List<StarSystemData> systems = new ArrayList<StarSystemData>();
307                        for (Constellation c : list) {
308                                for (StarSystemAPI system : c.getSystems()) {
309                                        StarSystemData data = computeSystemData(system);
310                                        systems.add(data);
311                                }
312                        }
313                                
314                        Collections.shuffle(systems, random);
315                        for (StarSystemData data  : systems) {
316                                boolean matches = false;
317                                for (String tag : data.system.getTags()) {
318                                        if (tags.contains(tag)) {
319                                                matches = true;
320                                                break;
321                                        }
322                                }
323                                if (!matches) continue;
324
325                                EntityLocation loc = pickAnyLocation(random, data.system, 70f, null);
326                                AddedEntity ae = addDerelictShip(data, loc, variant);
327                                if (ae != null) {
328                                        if (numSalvageable > 0) {
329                                                numSalvageable--;
330                                                ShipRecoverySpecialCreator creator = new ShipRecoverySpecialCreator(random, 0, 0, badCondition, null, null);
331                                                Object specialData = creator.createSpecial(ae.entity, new SpecialCreationContext());
332                                                if (specialData != null) {
333                                                        Misc.setSalvageSpecial(ae.entity, specialData);
334                                                }
335                                        } else {
336                                                numNonSalvageable--;
337                                                SalvageSpecialAssigner.assignSpecials(ae.entity, true);
338                                        }
339                                        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("      Added " + variant + " to " + data.system + "\n");
340                                }
341                                if (numSalvageable + numNonSalvageable <= 0) break;
342                        }
343                        //if (numSalvageable + numNonSalvageable <= 0) break;
344                        
345                        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Finished adding " + variant + " to star systems\n\n\n\n\n");
346                }
347        }

350        protected void addSolarShadesAndMirrors(ThemeGenContext context) {
351                
352                int num = 2 + random.nextInt(3);
353                
354                //System.out.println("RANDOM CHECK: " + random.nextLong());
355                
356                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Adding up to " + num + " solar shades and mirrors");
357                List<Constellation> list = new ArrayList<Constellation>(context.constellations);
358                WeightedRandomPicker<PlanetAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<PlanetAPI>(random);
359                for (Constellation c : list) {
360                        for (StarSystemAPI system : c.getSystems()) {
361                                if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_CORE)) continue;
362                                if (system.isNebula()) continue;
363                                
364                                for (PlanetAPI planet : system.getPlanets()) {
365                                        if (planet.isStar()) continue;
366                                        
367                                        SectorEntityToken focus = planet.getOrbitFocus();
368                                        if (!(focus instanceof PlanetAPI)) continue;
369                                        if (!((PlanetAPI) focus).isNormalStar()) continue;
370                                        
371                                        
372                                        PlanetGenDataSpec spec = (PlanetGenDataSpec) 
373                                                                                        Global.getSettings().getSpec(PlanetGenDataSpec.class, planet.getSpec().getPlanetType(), true);
374                                        if (spec == null) continue;
375                                        
376                                        String cat = spec.getCategory();
377                                        if (cat == null) continue;
378                                        
379                                        float weight = 0f;
380                                        if (Planets.CAT_HAB1.equals(cat)) {
381                                                weight = 1f;
382                                        } else if (Planets.CAT_HAB2.equals(cat)) {
383                                                weight = 1f;
384                                        } else if (Planets.CAT_HAB3.equals(cat)) {
385                                                weight = 1f;
386                                        }
387                                        
388                                        if (weight <= 0) continue;
389                                        
390                                        weight = 0;
391                                        
392                                        if (planet.hasCondition(Conditions.HOT)) {
393                                                weight += 5f;
394                                        }
395                                        if (planet.hasCondition(Conditions.POOR_LIGHT)) {
396                                                weight += 5f;
397                                        }
398                                        if (planet.hasCondition(Conditions.WATER_SURFACE)) {
399                                                weight += 5f;
400                                        }
401                                        if (Misc.hasFarmland(planet.getMarket())) {
402                                                weight += 10f;
403                                        }
404                                        
405                                        if (weight <= 0) continue;
406                                        
407                                        // +250 beyond normal radius
408                                        boolean enoughRoom = true;
409                                        for (PlanetAPI other : system.getPlanets()) {
410                                                if (other.getOrbitFocus() == planet) {
411                                                        if (other.getCircularOrbitRadius() < planet.getRadius() + other.getRadius() + 320) {
412                                                                enoughRoom = false;
413                                                                break;
414                                                        }
415                                                }
416                                        }
417                                        if (!enoughRoom) continue;
418                                        
419                                        
420                                        picker.add(planet, weight);
421                                }
422                        }
423                }
424                
425                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Found " + picker.getItems().size() + " candidates");
426                for (int i = 0; i < num && !picker.isEmpty(); i++) {
427                        PlanetAPI planet = picker.pickAndRemove();
428                        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Adding solar shades and mirrors to [" + planet.getName() + "] in [" + 
429                                        planet.getStarSystem() + " located at " + planet.getLocationInHyperspace());
430                        
431                        planet.getMarket().addCondition(Conditions.SOLAR_ARRAY);
432                        
433                        StarSystemAPI system = planet.getStarSystem();
434                        PlanetAPI star = (PlanetAPI) planet.getOrbitFocus();
435                        
436                        boolean shade = planet.hasCondition(Conditions.HOT) ||
437                                                                planet.getTypeId().equals(Planets.DESERT) ||
438                                                                planet.getTypeId().equals(Planets.DESERT1) ||
439                                                                planet.getTypeId().equals(Planets.ARID) ||
440                                                                star.getTypeId().equals(StarTypes.BLUE_GIANT) ||
441                                                                star.getTypeId().equals(StarTypes.BLUE_SUPERGIANT);
442                        boolean mirror = planet.hasCondition(Conditions.POOR_LIGHT) ||
443                                                                planet.getTypeId().equals(Planets.PLANET_TERRAN_ECCENTRIC) ||
444//                                                              star.getTypeId().equals(StarTypes.RED_SUPERGIANT) ||
445//                                                              star.getTypeId().equals(StarTypes.RED_GIANT) ||
446                                                                star.getTypeId().equals(StarTypes.RED_DWARF) ||
447                                                                star.getTypeId().equals(StarTypes.BROWN_DWARF);
448                        
449                        boolean forceFew = false; 
450                        if (!shade && !mirror) {
451                                mirror = true;
452                                shade = true;
453                                forceFew = true;
454                        }
455                        
456                        String faction = Factions.NEUTRAL;
457                        float period = planet.getCircularOrbitPeriod();
458                        float angle = planet.getCircularOrbitAngle();
459                        float radius = 270f + planet.getRadius();
460                        //String name = planet.getName();
461                        
462                        float xp = 300f;
463                        float profile = 2000f;
464                        
465                        if (mirror) {
466                                boolean manyMirrors = random.nextBoolean();
467                                
468                                SectorEntityToken mirror2 = system.addCustomEntity(null, "Stellar Mirror Beta", Entities.STELLAR_MIRROR, faction);      
469                                SectorEntityToken mirror3 = system.addCustomEntity(null, "Stellar Mirror Gamma", Entities.STELLAR_MIRROR, faction);
470                                SectorEntityToken mirror4 = system.addCustomEntity(null, "Stellar Mirror Delta", Entities.STELLAR_MIRROR, faction);
471                                mirror2.setCircularOrbitPointingDown(planet, angle - 30, radius, period);       
472                                mirror3.setCircularOrbitPointingDown(planet, angle + 0, radius, period);        
473                                mirror4.setCircularOrbitPointingDown(planet, angle + 30, radius, period);
474                                makeDiscoverable(mirror2, xp, profile);
475                                makeDiscoverable(mirror3, xp, profile);
476                                makeDiscoverable(mirror4, xp, profile);
477                                
478                                if (manyMirrors && !forceFew) {
479                                        SectorEntityToken mirror1 = system.addCustomEntity(null, "Stellar Mirror Alpha", Entities.STELLAR_MIRROR, faction);
480                                        SectorEntityToken mirror5 = system.addCustomEntity(null, "Stellar Mirror Epsilon", Entities.STELLAR_MIRROR, faction);
481                                        mirror1.setCircularOrbitPointingDown(planet, angle - 60, radius, period);
482                                        mirror5.setCircularOrbitPointingDown(planet, angle + 60, radius, period);
483                                        makeDiscoverable(mirror1, xp, profile);
484                                        makeDiscoverable(mirror5, xp, profile);
485                                }
486                        }
487                        
488                        if (shade) {
489                                boolean manyShades = random.nextBoolean();
490                                SectorEntityToken shade2 = system.addCustomEntity(null, "Stellar Shade Psi", Entities.STELLAR_SHADE, faction);
491                                shade2.setCircularOrbitPointingDown(planet, angle + 180 + 0, radius + 25, period);
492                                makeDiscoverable(shade2, xp, profile);
493                                
494                                if (manyShades && !forceFew) {
495                                        SectorEntityToken shade1 = system.addCustomEntity(null, "Stellar Shade Omega", Entities.STELLAR_SHADE, faction);
496                                        SectorEntityToken shade3 = system.addCustomEntity(null, "Stellar Shade Chi", Entities.STELLAR_SHADE, faction);
497                                        shade1.setCircularOrbitPointingDown(planet, angle + 180 - 26, radius - 10, period);
498                                        shade3.setCircularOrbitPointingDown(planet, angle + 180 + 26, radius - 10, period);
499                                        makeDiscoverable(shade1, xp, profile);
500                                        makeDiscoverable(shade3, xp, profile);
501                                }
502                        }
503                        
504                }
505                
506                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Done adding solar shades and mirrors");
507        }

509        public static void makeDiscoverable(SectorEntityToken entity, float xp, float sensorProfile) {
510                entity.setDiscoverable(true);
511                entity.setDiscoveryXP(xp);
512                entity.setSensorProfile(sensorProfile);
513        }

516        public void populateNonMain(StarSystemData data) {
517                if (DEBUG) System.out.println(" Generating misc derelicts in system " + data.system.getName());

550        protected void addExtraGates(ThemeGenContext context) {
551//              List<SectorEntityToken> gates = new ArrayList<SectorEntityToken>();
552//              List<StarSystemAPI> systems = new ArrayList<StarSystemAPI>();
553//              List<Constellation> list = new ArrayList<Constellation>(context.constellations);
554//              for (Constellation c : list) {
555//                      for (StarSystemAPI system : c.getSystems()) {
556//                              gates.addAll(system.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.GATE));
557//                              systems.add(system);
558//                      }
559//              }
560
561                List<StarSystemAPI> systems = new ArrayList<StarSystemAPI>(Global.getSector().getStarSystems());
562                List<SectorEntityToken> gates = new ArrayList<SectorEntityToken>();
563                
564                for (StarSystemAPI system : new ArrayList<StarSystemAPI>(systems)) {
565                        //if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_CORE)) continue; // this isn't set yet
566                        boolean galatia = system.getBaseName().toLowerCase().equals("galatia");
567                        if (system.getTags().isEmpty() || galatia) {
568                                systems.remove(system);
569                                continue;
570                        }
571                        gates.addAll(system.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.GATE));
572                }
573                
574                
575                int addGates = MIN_GATES + random.nextInt(MAX_GATES - MIN_GATES + 1) - gates.size();
576                if (addGates < MIN_GATES_TO_ADD) addGates = MIN_GATES_TO_ADD;
577                if (addGates <= 0) {
578                        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("  Already have " + gates.size() + " gates, not adding any");
579                        return;
580                }
581                
582                List<StarSystemData> all = new ArrayList<BaseThemeGenerator.StarSystemData>();
583                
584                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("");
585                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("");
586                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("");
587                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("  Adding " + addGates + " extra gates, for a total of " + (addGates + gates.size()));
588                
589                for (int i = 0; i < addGates; i++) {
590                        float maxDist = 0;
591                        StarSystemAPI farthest = null;
592                        for (StarSystemAPI system : systems) {
593                                if (system.getPlanets().size() < 3) continue; // skip empty systems
594                                
595                                float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
596                                for (SectorEntityToken gate : gates) {
597                                        float dist = Misc.getDistanceLY(gate, system.getCenter());
598                                        if (dist < minDist) minDist = dist;
599                                }
600                                if (minDist > maxDist) {
601                                        maxDist = minDist;
602                                        farthest = system;
603                                }
604                        }
605                        if (farthest != null) {
606                                StarSystemData data = new StarSystemData();
607                                data.system = farthest;
608                                WeightedRandomPicker<String> factions = SalvageSpecialAssigner.getNearbyFactions(random, farthest.getCenter(),
609                                                                                                                                                                15f, 5f, 5f);
610                                AddedEntity gate = addInactiveGate(data, 1f, 0.5f, 0.5f, factions);
611                                if (gate != null && gate.entity != null) gates.add(gate.entity);
612                        }
613                }
614                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("  Done adding extra gates");
615                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("");
616                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("");
617                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("");
618                
619                SpecialCreationContext specialContext = new SpecialCreationContext();
620                specialContext.themeId = getThemeId();
621                SalvageSpecialAssigner.assignSpecials(all, specialContext);
622                
623                
624                
625        }

628        protected void addCoronalTaps(ThemeGenContext context) {
629                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Adding coronal taps...");
630                
631                List<Constellation> list = new ArrayList<Constellation>(context.constellations);
632                
633                WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemAPI> tapSystems = new WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemAPI>(StarSystemGenerator.random);
634                WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemAPI> backup = new WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemAPI>(StarSystemGenerator.random);
635                for (Constellation c : list) {
636                        for (StarSystemAPI system : c.getSystems()) {
637                                if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_SPECIAL)) continue;
638                                
639                                float w = 0f;
640                                if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT)) {
641                                        w = 10f;
642                                } else if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_DERELICT)) {
643                                        w = 10f;
644                                } else if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_RUINS)) {
645                                        w = 10f;
646                                } else if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_MISC)) {
647                                        w = 5f;
648                                }
649        
650                                if (w <= 0) continue;
651        
652                                if (system.getType() == StarSystemType.TRINARY_2CLOSE) {
653                                        w *= 5f;
654                                }
655        
656                                boolean hasBlueStar = false;
657                                boolean hasNormalStar = false;
658                                for (PlanetAPI planet : system.getPlanets()) {
659                                        if (!planet.isNormalStar()) continue;
660                                        if (planet.getTypeId().equals(StarTypes.BLUE_GIANT) ||
661                                                        planet.getTypeId().equals(StarTypes.BLUE_SUPERGIANT)) { 
662                                                hasBlueStar = true;
663                                        }
664                                        hasNormalStar = true;
665                                }
666                                
667                                if (!hasNormalStar) continue;
668                                
669                                WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemAPI> use = tapSystems;
670                                if (!hasBlueStar) {
671                                        use = backup;
672                                }
673                                use.add(system, w);
674                        }
675                }
676                
677                
678//              if (tapSystems.isEmpty()) {
679//                      tapSystems.addAll(backup);
680//              }
681                
682                int numTaps = 2 + random.nextInt(2);
683                numTaps = 2;
684                int added = 0;
685                while (added < numTaps && (!tapSystems.isEmpty() || !backup.isEmpty())) {
686                        StarSystemAPI pick = tapSystems.pickAndRemove();
687                        if (pick == null) {
688                                pick = backup.pickAndRemove();
689                        }
690                        if (pick == null) break;
691                        AddedEntity tap = addCoronalTap(pick);
692                        if (tap != null) {
693                                added++;
694                        }
695                }
696                
697                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Done adding coronal taps\n\n\n");
698        }

700        public static class MakeCoronalTapFaceNearestStar implements EveryFrameScript {
701                protected SectorEntityToken tap;
702                public MakeCoronalTapFaceNearestStar(SectorEntityToken tap) {
703                        this.tap = tap;
704                }
705                public void advance(float amount) {
706                        if (!tap.isInCurrentLocation()) return;
707                        
708                        float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
709                        PlanetAPI closest = null;
710                        for (PlanetAPI star : tap.getContainingLocation().getPlanets()) {
711                                if (!star.isStar()) continue;
712                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(tap.getLocation(), star.getLocation());
713                                if (dist < minDist) {
714                                        minDist = dist;
715                                        closest = star;
716                                }
717                        }
718                        if (closest != null) {
719                                tap.setFacing(Misc.getAngleInDegrees(tap.getLocation(), closest.getLocation()) + 180f);
720                        }                       
721                }
722                public boolean isDone() {
723                        return false;
724                }
725                public boolean runWhilePaused() {
726                        return false;
727                }
728        }

730        protected AddedEntity addCoronalTap(StarSystemAPI system) {
731                
732                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Adding coronal tap to [" + system.getNameWithLowercaseType() + ", " + system.getLocation());
733                
734                String factionId = Factions.NEUTRAL;
735                
736                AddedEntity entity = null;
737                if (system.getType() == StarSystemType.TRINARY_2CLOSE) {
738                        EntityLocation loc = new EntityLocation();
739                        loc.location = new Vector2f();
740                        entity = addEntity(random, system, loc, Entities.CORONAL_TAP, factionId);
741                        if (entity != null) {
742                                system.addScript(new MakeCoronalTapFaceNearestStar(entity.entity));
743                        }
744                } else {
745                        WeightedRandomPicker<PlanetAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<PlanetAPI>();
746                        WeightedRandomPicker<PlanetAPI> fallback = new WeightedRandomPicker<PlanetAPI>();
747                        for (PlanetAPI planet : system.getPlanets()) {
748                                if (!planet.isNormalStar()) continue;
749                                if (planet.getTypeId().equals(StarTypes.BLUE_GIANT) ||
750                                                planet.getTypeId().equals(StarTypes.BLUE_SUPERGIANT)) {
751                                        picker.add(planet);
752                                } else {
753                                        fallback.add(planet);
754                                }
755                        }
756                        if (picker.isEmpty()) {
757                                picker.addAll(fallback);
758                        }
759                        
760                        PlanetAPI star = picker.pick();
761                        if (star != null) {
762                                CustomEntitySpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getCustomEntitySpec(Entities.CORONAL_TAP);
763                                EntityLocation loc = new EntityLocation();
764                                float orbitRadius = star.getRadius() + spec.getDefaultRadius() + 100f;
765                                float orbitDays = orbitRadius / 20f;
766                                loc.orbit = Global.getFactory().createCircularOrbitPointingDown(star, random.nextFloat() * 360f, orbitRadius, orbitDays);
767                                entity = addEntity(random, system, loc, Entities.CORONAL_TAP, factionId);
768                        }
769                }
770                
771                
772                if (entity != null) {
773                        system.addScript(new CoronalTapParticleScript(entity.entity));
774//                      system.addCorona(entity.entity, Terrain.CORONA_JET,
775//                                      500f, // radius outside planet
776//                                      15f, // burn level of "wind"
777//                                      0f, // flare probability
778//                                      1f // CR loss mult while in it
779//                                      );
780                        
781//                      system.addTag(Tags.THEME_DERELICT);
782                        system.addTag(Tags.HAS_CORONAL_TAP);
783                }
784                
785                if (DEBUG) {
786                        if (entity != null) {
787                                System.out.println(String.format("  Added coronal tap to %s", system.getNameWithLowercaseType()));
788                        } else {
789                                System.out.println(String.format("  Failed to add coronal tap to %s", system.getNameWithLowercaseType()));
790                        }
791                }
792                return entity;
793        }

796        protected void addPKSystem(ThemeGenContext context) {
797                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Looking for system to hide PK in");
798                
799                List<StarSystemAPI> preferred = new ArrayList<StarSystemAPI>();
800                List<StarSystemAPI> other = new ArrayList<StarSystemAPI>();
801                
802                for (Constellation c : context.constellations) {
803                        for (StarSystemAPI system : c.getSystems()) {
804                                if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_SPECIAL)) continue;
805                                
806                                if (system.isNebula()) continue;
807                                if (system.hasPulsar()) continue;
808                                if (system.hasBlackHole()) continue;
809                                
810                                boolean misc = system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_MISC_SKIP) || system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_MISC);
811                                if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_DERELICT)) misc = false;
812                                
813                                boolean nonLargeDerelict = system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_DERELICT) && 
814                                                                                !system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_DERELICT_MOTHERSHIP) &&
815                                                                                !system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_DERELICT_CRYOSLEEPER) &&
816                                                                                !system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_DERELICT_SURVEY_SHIP);
817                                
818                                boolean secondaryRuins = system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_RUINS_SECONDARY);
819                                boolean remnantNoFleets = system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_NO_FLEETS);
820                                boolean unsafe = system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_UNSAFE);
821                                
822                                if (unsafe || !(misc || nonLargeDerelict || secondaryRuins || remnantNoFleets)) {
823                                        continue;
824                                }
825                                
826                                int count = 0;
827                                for (PlanetAPI curr : system.getPlanets()) {
828                                        if (curr.isStar()) continue;
829                                        if (curr.isMoon()) continue;
830                                        if (curr.isGasGiant()) continue;
831                                        if (!curr.getMarket().isPlanetConditionMarketOnly()) continue;
832                                        if (curr.getCircularOrbitRadius() < 6000) continue;
833                                        if (curr.hasTag(Tags.NOT_RANDOM_MISSION_TARGET)) continue;
834                                        count++;
835                                }
836                                
837                                if (count > 0) {
838                                        preferred.add(system);
839                                } else {
840                                        other.add(system);
841                                }
842                        }
843                }
844                
845                Comparator<StarSystemAPI> comp = new Comparator<StarSystemAPI>() {
846                        public int compare(StarSystemAPI o1, StarSystemAPI o2) {
847                                return (int) Math.signum(o2.getLocation().length() - o1.getLocation().length());
848                        }
849                };
850
851                List<StarSystemAPI> sorted = new ArrayList<StarSystemAPI>();
852                if (!preferred.isEmpty()) {
853                        sorted.addAll(preferred);
854                } else {
855                        sorted.addAll(other);
856                }
857                if (sorted.isEmpty()) {
858                        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("FAILED TO FIND SUITABLE SYSTEM FOR PK");
859                        return;
860                }
861                Collections.sort(sorted, comp);
862                
863                
864                // pick from some of the matching systems furthest from core
865                WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<StarSystemAPI>(random);
866                for (int i = 0; i < 20 && i < sorted.size(); i++) {
867                        //sorted.get(i).addTag(Tags.PK_SYSTEM);
868                        picker.add(sorted.get(i), 1f);
869                }
870                
871                StarSystemAPI system = picker.pick();
872                
873                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Adding PK to [" + system.getName() + "] at [" + system.getLocation() + "]");
874                setUpPKSystem(system);
875                
876                
877                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Finished adding PK system\n\n\n\n\n");
878        }

880        protected void setUpPKSystem(StarSystemAPI system) {
881                system.addTag(Tags.THEME_SPECIAL);
882                system.addTag(Tags.SYSTEM_ALREADY_USED_FOR_STORY);
883                system.addTag(Tags.PK_SYSTEM);
884                
885                Global.getSector().getPersistentData().put(PK_SYSTEM_KEY, system);
886                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(PK_SYSTEM_KEY, system.getId());
887                
888                // - pick a planet at 6k range or higher to make into a tundra world
889                // - turn any planets with a lower hazard rating into barren and reassign their conditions 
890                
891                PlanetAPI tundra = null;
892                for (PlanetAPI curr : system.getPlanets()) {
893                        if (curr.isStar()) continue;
894                        //if (curr.isMoon()) continue;
895                        if (curr.isGasGiant()) continue;
896                        if (curr.getMarket() == null) continue;
897                        if (!curr.getMarket().isPlanetConditionMarketOnly()) continue;
898                        if (curr.getCircularOrbitRadius() < 6000) continue;
899                        
900                        tundra = curr;
901                        break;
902                }
903                
904                //pick = null;
905                
906                // if there's no planet in a suitable range, create one
907                // could end up with a tundra world really far out if the system is full of stuff
908                // but has no planets, but it's unlikely
909                if (tundra == null) {
910                        List<OrbitGap> gaps = BaseThemeGenerator.findGaps(system.getCenter(), 6000, 20000, 800);
911                        float orbitRadius = 7000;
912                        if (!gaps.isEmpty()) {
913                                orbitRadius = (gaps.get(0).start + gaps.get(0).end) * 0.5f;
914                        }
915                        float orbitDays = orbitRadius / (20f + random.nextFloat() * 5f);
916                        float radius = 100f + random.nextFloat() * 50f;
917                        float angle = random.nextFloat() * 360f;
918                        String type = Planets.BARREN;
919                        NamePick namePick = ProcgenUsedNames.pickName(NameGenData.TAG_PLANET, null, null);
920                        String name = namePick.nameWithRomanSuffixIfAny;
921                        tundra = system.addPlanet(Misc.genUID(), system.getStar(), name, type, angle, radius, orbitRadius, orbitDays);
922                        
923                        if (tundra == null) {
924                                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("FAILED TO CREATE PLANET IN PK SYSTEM");
925                                return;
926                        }
927                }
928                
929                tundra.setName("Sentinel");
930                tundra.getMarket().setName("Sentinel");
931                tundra.addTag(Tags.NOT_RANDOM_MISSION_TARGET);
932                tundra.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(PK_PLANET_KEY, true);
933                Global.getSector().getPersistentData().put(PK_PLANET_KEY, tundra);
934                
935                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Setting planet [" + tundra.getName() + "] to tundra");
936                tundra.changeType(Planets.TUNDRA, random);
937                tundra.getMarket().getConditions().clear();
938                PlanetConditionGenerator.generateConditionsForPlanet(null, tundra, system.getAge());
939                tundra.getMarket().removeCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED);
940                tundra.getMarket().removeCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED_SUBPOP);
941                tundra.getMarket().removeCondition(Conditions.RUINS_EXTENSIVE);
942                tundra.getMarket().removeCondition(Conditions.RUINS_SCATTERED);
943                tundra.getMarket().removeCondition(Conditions.RUINS_VAST);
944                tundra.getMarket().removeCondition(Conditions.RUINS_WIDESPREAD);
945                tundra.getMarket().removeCondition(Conditions.INIMICAL_BIOSPHERE);
946                
947                tundra.getMarket().removeCondition(Conditions.FARMLAND_POOR);
948                tundra.getMarket().removeCondition(Conditions.FARMLAND_ADEQUATE);
949                tundra.getMarket().removeCondition(Conditions.FARMLAND_RICH);
950                tundra.getMarket().removeCondition(Conditions.FARMLAND_BOUNTIFUL);
951                tundra.getMarket().addCondition(Conditions.FARMLAND_POOR);
952
953                
954                // make sure the tundra world is the best habitable world in-system so there's no questions
955                // as to why it was chosen by the survivors
956                float pickHazard = tundra.getMarket().getHazardValue();
957                
958                for (PlanetAPI curr : system.getPlanets()) {
959                        if (curr.isStar()) continue;
960                        if (curr.isGasGiant()) continue;
961                        if (curr.getMarket() == null) continue;
962                        if (!curr.getMarket().isPlanetConditionMarketOnly()) continue;
963                        if (curr == tundra) continue;
964                        
965                        float h = curr.getMarket().getHazardValue();
966                        if (curr.hasCondition(Conditions.HABITABLE) && h <= pickHazard) {
967                                curr.changeType(Planets.BARREN_VENUSLIKE, random);
968                                curr.getMarket().getConditions().clear();
969                                PlanetConditionGenerator.generateConditionsForPlanet(null, curr, system.getAge());
970                        }
971                }
972                
973                for (SectorEntityToken curr : system.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.STABLE_LOCATION)) {
974                        system.removeEntity(curr);
975                }
976                for (SectorEntityToken curr : system.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.OBJECTIVE)) {
977                        system.removeEntity(curr);
978                }
979                
980                
981                List<OrbitGap> gaps = BaseThemeGenerator.findGaps(system.getCenter(), 2000, 20000, 800);
982                float orbitRadius = 7000;
983                if (!gaps.isEmpty()) {
984                        orbitRadius = (gaps.get(0).start + gaps.get(0).end) * 0.5f;
985                }
986                float radius = 500f + 200f * random.nextFloat();
987                float area = radius * radius * 3.14f;
988                int count = (int) (area / 80000f);
989                count *= 2;
990                if (count < 10) count = 10;
991                if (count > 100) count = 100;
992                float angle = random.nextFloat() * 360f;
993                float orbitDays = orbitRadius / (20f + random.nextFloat() * 5f);
994                
995                SectorEntityToken field = system.addTerrain(Terrain.ASTEROID_FIELD,
996                                new AsteroidFieldParams(
997                                        radius, // min radius
998                                        radius + 100f, // max radius
999                                        count, // min asteroid count
1000                                        count, // max asteroid count
1001                                        4f, // min asteroid radius 
1002                                        16f, // max asteroid radius
1003                                        null)); // null for default name
1004                
1005                field.setCircularOrbit(system.getCenter(), angle, orbitRadius, orbitDays);
1006                
1007                SectorEntityToken cache = BaseThemeGenerator.addSalvageEntity(system, Entities.HIDDEN_CACHE, Factions.NEUTRAL);
1008                cache.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(PK_CACHE_KEY, true);
1009                cache.addTag(Tags.NOT_RANDOM_MISSION_TARGET);
1010                //cache.getLocation().set(10000, 10000);
1011                cache.setCircularOrbit(field, 0, 0, 100f);
1012                Misc.setDefenderOverride(cache, new DefenderDataOverride(Factions.HEGEMONY, 1f, 20, 20, 1));
1013                
1014                // Misc.addDefeatTrigger(fleet, trigger);
1015                
1016                // add a ship graveyard around the cache - Luddic Path ships, presumably from another
1017                // Path operative that got farther along but never reported back
1018                StarSystemData data = new StarSystemData();
1019                WeightedRandomPicker<String> derelictShipFactions = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
1020                derelictShipFactions.add(Factions.LUDDIC_PATH);
1021                WeightedRandomPicker<String> hulls = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
1022                hulls.add("prometheus2", 1f);
1023                hulls.add("colossus2", 1f);
1024                hulls.add("colossus2", 1f);
1025                hulls.add("colossus2", 1f);
1026                hulls.add("eradicator", 1f);
1027                hulls.add("enforcer", 1f);
1028                hulls.add("sunder", 1f);
1029                hulls.add("venture_pather", 1f);
1030                hulls.add("manticore_luddic_path", 1f);
1031                hulls.add("cerberus_luddic_path", 1f);
1032                hulls.add("hound_luddic_path", 1f);
1033                hulls.add("buffalo2", 1f);
1034                addShipGraveyard(data, field, derelictShipFactions, hulls);
1035                for (AddedEntity ae : data.generated) {
1036                        SalvageSpecialAssigner.assignSpecials(ae.entity, true);
1037                }
1038                
1039                // add some remnant derelicts around a fringe jump-point
1040                // where the fight was
1041                float max = 0f;
1042                JumpPointAPI fringePoint = null;
1043                List<JumpPointAPI> points = system.getEntities(JumpPointAPI.class);
1044                for (JumpPointAPI curr : points) {
1045                        float dist = curr.getCircularOrbitRadius();
1046                        if (dist > max) {
1047                                max = dist;
1048                                fringePoint = curr;
1049                        }
1050                }
1051                
1052                if (fringePoint != null) {
1053                        data = new StarSystemData();
1054                        WeightedRandomPicker<String> remnantShipFactions = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
1055                        remnantShipFactions.add(Factions.REMNANTS);
1056                        hulls = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
1057                        hulls.add("radiant", 0.25f);
1058                        hulls.add("nova", 0.5f);
1059                        hulls.add("brilliant", 1f);
1060                        hulls.add("apex", 1f);
1061                        hulls.add("scintilla", 1f);
1062                        hulls.add("scintilla", 1f);
1063                        hulls.add("fulgent", 1f);
1064                        hulls.add("fulgent", 1f);
1065                        hulls.add("glimmer", 1f);
1066                        hulls.add("glimmer", 1f);
1067                        hulls.add("lumen", 1f);
1068                        hulls.add("lumen", 1f);
1069                        addShipGraveyard(data, fringePoint, remnantShipFactions, hulls);
1070                        addDebrisField(data, fringePoint, 400f);
1071                        
1072                        for (AddedEntity ae : data.generated) {
1073                                SalvageSpecialAssigner.assignSpecials(ae.entity, true);
1074                                if (ae.entity.getCustomPlugin() instanceof DerelictShipEntityPlugin) {
1075                                        DerelictShipEntityPlugin plugin = (DerelictShipEntityPlugin) ae.entity.getCustomPlugin();
1076                                        plugin.getData().ship.condition = ShipCondition.WRECKED;
1077                                }
1078                        }
1079                }
1080                
1081                // Improvised dockyard where presumably the ship conversion took place
1082                SectorEntityToken dockyard = system.addCustomEntity("pk_dockyard",
1083                                "Sentinel Gantries", Entities.ORBITAL_DOCKYARD, "neutral");
1084
1085                dockyard.setCircularOrbitPointingDown(tundra, 45, 300, 30);             
1086                dockyard.setCustomDescriptionId("pk_orbital_dockyard");
1087                dockyard.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$pkDockyard", true);
1088                
1089                //neutralStation.setInteractionImage("illustrations", "abandoned_station2");
1090                Misc.setAbandonedStationMarket("pk_dockyard", dockyard);
1091                
1092                
1093                // add some unused stuff to the dockyard
1094                CargoAPI cargo = dockyard.getMarket().getSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_STORAGE).getCargo();
1095                cargo.initMothballedShips(Factions.HEGEMONY);
1096                
1097                CampaignFleetAPI temp = Global.getFactory().createEmptyFleet(Factions.HEGEMONY, null, true);
1098                temp.getFleetData().addFleetMember("enforcer_XIV_Elite");
1099                temp.getFleetData().addFleetMember("enforcer_XIV_Elite");
1100                temp.getFleetData().addFleetMember("eagle_xiv_Elite");
1101                temp.getFleetData().addFleetMember("dominator_XIV_Elite");
1102                DefaultFleetInflaterParams p = new DefaultFleetInflaterParams();
1103                p.quality = -1;
1104                temp.setInflater(new DefaultFleetInflater(p));
1105                temp.inflateIfNeeded();
1106                temp.setInflater(null);
1107
1108                int index = 0;
1109                for (FleetMemberAPI member : temp.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
1110                        for (String slotId : member.getVariant().getFittedWeaponSlots()) {
1111                                String weaponId = member.getVariant().getWeaponId(slotId);
1112                                if (random.nextFloat() < 0.5f) {
1113                                        member.getVariant().clearSlot(slotId);
1114                                }
1115                                if (random.nextFloat() < 0.25f) {
1116                                        cargo.addWeapons(weaponId, 1);
1117                                }
1118                        }
1119                        if (index == 0 || index == 2) {
1120                                cargo.getMothballedShips().addFleetMember(member);
1121                        }
1122                        index++;
1123                }
1124                cargo.addCommodity(Commodities.METALS, 50f + random.nextInt(51));
1125                
1126                List<CampaignFleetAPI> stations = getRemnantStations(true, false);
1127                float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
1128                CampaignFleetAPI nexus = null;
1129                for (CampaignFleetAPI curr : stations) {
1130                        float dist = Misc.getDistanceLY(tundra, curr);
1131                        if (dist < minDist) {
1132                                minDist = dist;
1133                                nexus = curr;
1134                        }
1135                }
1136                if (nexus != null) {
1137                        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Found Remnant nexus in [" + nexus.getContainingLocation().getName() + "]");
1138                        nexus.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(PK_NEXUS_KEY, true);
1139                        Global.getSector().getPersistentData().put(PK_NEXUS_KEY, nexus);
1140                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(PK_NEXUS_KEY, nexus.getContainingLocation().getId());
1141                        
1142                        Misc.addDefeatTrigger(nexus, "PKNexusDefeated");
1143                }
1144        }

1146        protected void addLOCRLuddicPlanet(ThemeGenContext context) {
1147                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Looking for LOCR_LUDDIC planet");
1148                
1149                WeightedRandomPicker<PlanetAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<PlanetAPI>(random);
1150                WeightedRandomPicker<PlanetAPI> picker_fallback = new WeightedRandomPicker<PlanetAPI>(random);
1151
1152                // looking for a habitable planet in the fringe WITH good farming
1153                for (Constellation c : context.constellations) {
1154                        for (StarSystemAPI system : c.getSystems()) {
1155                                
1156                                if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_SPECIAL)) continue;
1157                                if (system.isNebula()) continue;
1158                                if (system.hasPulsar()) continue;
1159                                if (system.hasBlackHole()) continue;
1160                                if (!system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_MISC_SKIP) && !system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_MISC)) continue;
1161                                if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_DERELICT)) continue;
1162                                
1163                                for (PlanetAPI curr : system.getPlanets()) {
1164                                        if (curr.isStar()) continue;
1165                                        if (!curr.getMarket().isPlanetConditionMarketOnly()) continue;  
1166                                        
1167                                        if (curr.hasTag(Tags.NOT_RANDOM_MISSION_TARGET)) continue;
1168                                        if (curr.getMarket().hasCondition(Conditions.WATER_SURFACE)) continue; // Ludd gets seasick, I guess.
1169                                        if (curr.isGasGiant()) continue; // I mean, let's just be sure, right?
1170                                        if (curr.getMarket().hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED_SUBPOP)) continue;
1171                                        
1172                                        // must have good farmland! Or at least OK farmland.
1173                                        if (curr.getMarket().hasCondition("farmland_rich") || curr.getMarket().hasCondition("farmland_bountiful"))
1174                                        {
1175                                                picker.add(curr);
1176                                        }
1177                                        else if ( curr.getMarket().hasCondition("farmland_adequate"))
1178                                        {
1179                                                picker_fallback.add(curr);
1180                                        }
1181                                }
1182                        }
1183                }
1184
1185                PlanetAPI planet = picker.pick();
1186                if (planet == null) 
1187                {
1188                        planet = picker_fallback.pick();
1189                }
1190                
1191                if (planet != null) {
1192                        
1193                        // add the ship they came in on
1194                        
1195                        DerelictShipData params = new DerelictShipData(new PerShipData("nebula_Standard", ShipCondition.BATTERED, 0f), false);
1196                        params.ship.shipName = "CGR Light of Exultation";
1197                        params.ship.nameAlwaysKnown = true;
1198                        //params.ship.fleetMemberId = id;
1199                        
1200                        SectorEntityToken ship = BaseThemeGenerator.addSalvageEntity(planet.getStarSystem(), Entities.WRECK, Factions.NEUTRAL, params);
1201                        ship.setDiscoverable(true);
1202                        float orbitDays = 200f / (10f + (float) Math.random() * 5f);
1203                        ship.setCircularOrbit(planet, (float) Math.random() * 360f, planet.getRadius() + 100f, orbitDays);
1204                        ShipRecoverySpecialCreator creator = new ShipRecoverySpecialCreator(null, 0, 0, false, null, null);
1205                        Misc.setSalvageSpecial(ship, creator.createSpecial(ship, null));
1206                        
1207                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(LOCR_LUDDIC_TRANSPORT_KEY, ship);
1208                        //ship.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(LOCR_LUDDIC, true);
1209                        
1210                        
1211                        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Adding LOCR_LUDDIC flag to [" + planet.getName() + "] in [" + planet.getContainingLocation().getNameWithLowercaseType() + "]");
1212                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(LOCR_LUDDIC_PLANET_KEY, planet);
1213                        planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(LOCR_LUDDIC, true);
1214                        planet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(LOCR_BLOCK_FIRST_SURVEY, true);
1215                        
1216                        long seed = StarSystemGenerator.random.nextLong();
1217                        planet.addTag(Tags.NOT_RANDOM_MISSION_TARGET);
1218                        
1219                } else {
1220                        if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Failed to find a LOCR_LUDDIC planet, may Ludd forgive you.");
1221                }
1222                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Finished adding LOCR_LUDDIC  planet\n\n\n");
1223        }

1368        public static List<CampaignFleetAPI> getRemnantStations(boolean includeDamaged, boolean onlyDamaged) {
1369                List<CampaignFleetAPI> stations = new ArrayList<CampaignFleetAPI>();
1370                for (StarSystemAPI system : Global.getSector().getStarSystems()) {
1371                        if (!system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_MAIN)) continue;
1372                        if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_REMNANT_DESTROYED)) continue;
1373                        
1374                        for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : system.getFleets()) {
1375                                if (!fleet.isStationMode()) continue;
1376                                if (!Factions.REMNANTS.equals(fleet.getFaction().getId())) continue;
1377                                
1378                                boolean damaged = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$damagedStation");
1379                                if (damaged && !includeDamaged) continue;
1380                                if (!damaged && onlyDamaged) continue;
1381                                
1382                                stations.add(fleet);
1383                        }
1384                }
1385                return stations;
1386        }
1387}
